title: The MUC19 gene: An evolutionary history of recurrent introgression and natural selection | Science
content: We study the gene MUC19, for which some modern humans carry a Denisovan-like haplotype. MUC19 is a mucin, a glycoprotein that forms gels with various biological functions. We find diagnostic variants for the Denisovan-like MUC19 haplotype at high ...
